signals.title: Holders ~24% underwater — and still not selling
signals.detail: MVRV 0.76: price is 24% below the crowd's avg on-chain cost basis ($0.504). Yet 57% of supply is in the longest-held tier — the float isn't moving. MVRV has slipped 1.06→0.76 over ~30d.
signals.framing: Maximum financial pain, minimal capitulation — conviction being tested and, so far, holding.
signals.note: Describe the divergence, NOT a bottom call. "Not selling", not "buy".

signals.title: -83% below its all-time high
signals.detail: Deepest drawdown on record was -92%; it has made new highs after every prior one so far.
signals.framing: Deep drawdowns are the toll — it's paid them before (no recovery promise).
signals.note: It's deep and unrecovered NOW; don't imply it always recovers.

signals.title: SPX's MVRV 0.81 = 4th percentile of Bitcoin's history
signals.detail: SPX's MVRV of 0.81 sits at the 4th percentile of Bitcoin's entire MVRV history — as cheap as BTC's generational bottoms.
signals.framing: MVRV is unitless, so it's comparable: SPX today is at BTC's 4th percentile. BTC was only this cheap at major bottoms.
signals.note: A position on BTC's map, not a date-match forecast.
